errors.text_span: За TR-S показателя стойностите са около 0.45 за Greedy(CodeLlama-7B), 0.45 за RPG(CodeLlama-7B), около 0.45 за Greedy(CodeLlama-34B) и около 0.45 за RPG(CodeLlama-34B).
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly reports the values for the TR-S metric, claiming they are all around 0.45. The actual approximate values are: Greedy(CodeLlama-7B) is ~0.69, RPG(CodeLlama-7B) is ~0.42, Greedy(CodeLlama-34B) is ~0.45, and RPG(CodeLlama-34B) is ~0.31.
The description incorrectly states that there are no grouped or stacked bars. The chart is a grouped bar chart, with bars organized into four groups, one for each metric on the x-axis.
The description fails to mention the up and down arrows (↑, ↓) that are part of the labels for the metrics on the x-axis (e.g., EGP ↑, TR-N ↓).

errors.text_span: The chart displays four groups of bars, each representing a specific combination of method and LLM size
errors.evidence: The chart is structured into four groups of bars based on the x-axis metrics (EGP, TR-N, TR-S, CCP). Each of these groups contains four individual bars, one for each combination of method and LLM size listed in the legend. The description incorrectly implies that there are only four groups in total and that each group corresponds to a legend entry.
In the TR-N metric group, the value for the dark orange bar (RPG CodeLlama-34B) is approximately 0.4, not 0.8.

errors.evidence: Multiple values reported for the TR-S metric group are incorrect. The value for blue is approximately 0.7 (not 0.45), the value for orange is approximately 0.42 (not 0.35), and the value for dark orange is approximately 0.31 (not 0.45).
